rules.scope: 17 nominal D6 laboratory channels and one existing MAST WISE 0855 spectrum; no new sky fields or fits
rules.shift_interpretation: sensitivity only; not a QR2/QR3 release mapping or correction
rules.spectrum_mask: DQ==0, flux/error finite, error>0; negative flux retained
rules.weighting: photon convention: F_nu*R/lambda, normalized by R/lambda; diagnostic, pipeline calibration convention not verified
rules.missing_support: no extrapolation, no bridging invalid samples; full-band mean null if any nonzero absolute response weight unsupported
rules.uncertainty: no diagonal independent-sample error or confidence interval; full spectral covariance/calibration/variability unknown
rules.numerical_failure: retain every attempt; numerical integration failures are separate from partial spectral support, never zero flux
qualifications: R7 laboratory response is not the exact per-pixel QR2 response; no detector-coordinate binding is performed.
Signed response samples cannot serve as nonnegative physical photon truth without a separately validated model.
No centroid, motion, astrometric truth, injection, detection or scientific promotion is produced.
Cent and Allpix share laboratory measurements; they are sensitivity variants, not independent validation sources.

laboratory.release: R7 / July 22 2026 documentation; tar last modified August 26 2026
